title: the 0630 queue, worked: every measurable row landed, every contract row froze with a price, and a real deck re-priced the codec
decision: coordination record retained; the ranked queue in HOTSPOTS.md refreshed; no production change of its own
code_state: this record modifies only documentation; the wave's production changes are the records 0632-0650 it closes, each merged with its own commit
reason_codes: nineteen records (0632-0650) worked the queue change 0630 left: ten landed value-identical production changes, three froze designs with a sizing measurement and admission gates, three fixed correctness defects, one attributed an open regression, one built selectors, one closed gate gaps; every number in this record is quoted from the record that measured it

no claim-registry entry is created by this record or by any record of the wave; the paired medians and counts are evidence at their records' tiers and floors
